muc.title: Ask a question, or hand over a task?
muc.text: Chat means ask one thing, get one answer. Cowork is different: it's an AI agent. You hand over a whole task, then go do something else.

muc.title: Describe the result, Claude makes the plan
muc.text: You describe the result you want. Claude makes a plan on its own, splits it into steps, and works through them one by one.

muc.title: Many steps
muc.text: It reads your files, searches the web for more, builds spreadsheets with formulas, and makes slides. Many small tasks even run at the same time.

muc.title: Close your laptop, the work keeps going
muc.text: The work runs in the cloud, so you can close your laptop and it keeps going. You can follow along on the web, the desktop app or your phone.

muc.title: You're still at the wheel
muc.text: For sensitive steps like sending emails or deleting files, read the plan and approve it yourself first. You hand over the work, but you're still the one driving.

muc.title: Which plan? On a schedule?
muc.text: Cowork needs a paid plan, Pro and up. To have a task run on a schedule every week, use a scheduled task, as in video 31.

muc.title: Three options, one recommendation
muc.text: Gather three quotes or three options you're torn between, and ask Cowork to make a comparison table and recommend one, explaining why. Then double-check the numbers.

muc.title: Claude in the tools you use
muc.text: Don't want to leave your browser or Excel? Part 7: Claude right inside the tools you already use.
